conclusions.claim: All24 actual complete-file cases pass; only the deliberate bad-option cases omit readiness.
All4 PS5.1 no-installer variants timeout at15seconds after script-enter/join-path-begin, including native-only.
The15second diagnostic ceiling is shorter than the observed PS5.1 complete-entry preparation envelope; a Utility-export-specific cause is not supported.
Underlying Windows first-command delay cause and cold/warm reuse benefit are not established by these receipts.
Filesystem mtimes provide timing envelopes, not per-phase elapsed or exact process-exit timestamps.
